source: me.json has the fields id, name, email, and picture of the Graph API User reference (https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api/reference/user/), read 2026-10-24. The subject is Better Auth 1.7.2's accountSubject of facebook for a /me profile: profile.id (@better-auth/core 1.7.2 dist/social-providers/facebook.mjs). The Graph API has no verified flag, so the address is not verified.
